title: Temporary Service Outage – Please Stay Tuned
mainText:
We hope this message finds you well.

We are writing to inform you that our application is currently experiencing a temporary outage following the recent update, which includes our exciting new "Experience Level" feature. Our team is working diligently to resolve the issue and restore full service as quickly as possible.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and understanding during this time. Please stay tuned for further updates, and we will notify you as soon as everything is back up and running.

Thank you for your continued support.
